name: hms-guides
description: Generator for the HMS developer guides. Separate from the API and app on purpose — it is documentation tooling, not part of the system.

scripts.all: node guide-03.cjs && node guide-04.cjs && node guide-05.cjs

comment: The `all` script only covers guides whose source file exists here. Guides 01 and 02 predate this generator and their .docx files are committed — they do not need regenerating. Guide 04 was written retrospectively; see its section 9.
